hook: Five dollars a month for wholesale AI models.
hookText: Wholesale AI for five dollars a month

beats.say: Moat is a membership that calls itself the Costco of AI: five dollars a month for access to top models at wholesale prices, with no limits.
Members pool their usage into hundreds of trillions of tokens, and every model runs at full weights, benchmarked by Moat, at one price per model.
On a two-hundred-dollar monthly mix, the example member keeps one thousand four hundred twenty-eight dollars a year.
